stories.title: Bluetongue cases in Wales reach 516, including seven in Flintshire
stories.summary: Bluetongue has been confirmed at seven premises in Flintshire since the disease season began in July, government figures show. Bluetongue is a virus spread by midges which affects animals including sheep and cattle. Across Wales there have been 516 cases this season, compared with 24 in the whole of the previous season. stories.title: Minister blocks export of 1662 painting of Llannerch Park, Denbighshire
stories.summary: UK Government has temporarily blocked a 1662 painting of Llannerch Park in Denbighshire from leaving the country, in the hope that a British gallery can buy it for £550,000. stories.title: Flintshire school transport changes stall as consultation call is voted down
stories.summary: A cross-party group agreed changes months ago, but cabinet wants costings and impact checks first and the council has struggled to find staff to do them.

stories.title: New pedestrian crossing planned for A550 Hawarden Road in Hope
stories.summary: A crossing with traffic lights is planned for the A550 Hawarden Road in Hope, between the Fagl Lane and Kiln Lane junctions. stories.title: Woman who spat in police officer’s face jailed for 58 weeks at Mold Crown Court
stories.summary: A woman who spat in a police officer’s face has been jailed for 58 weeks at Mold Crown Court. Kimberley Ann Evans, 31, of no fixed abode, was sentenced on 16 November after previously admitting assaulting an emergency worker, North Wales Police said.
